function: SIM phase-shift (wave-domain precoding) configuration: unfolded projected-gradient network UPGD-Net maximizes the worst-link SINR, a BER surrogate, for each OFDM-IM activation pattern (p. 8-9).
system: Downlink wideband OFDM-IM: BS with S=4 antennas feeding a 7-layer transmissive stacked SIM (M=100 meta-atoms per layer), K=4 single-antenna users; 28 GHz, 60 MHz, 16 subcarriers (p. 3, 10).
method: Deep unfolding of projected gradient descent (UPGD-Net, T=30 stages); only per-iteration step sizes are trainable; unsupervised loss, negative worst-link SINR; Adam, offline training (p. 9-10).
data_channel: Own tapped-delay-line channel (Eq. 7), 10 taps set 'following 3GPP TR 38.901 guidelines'; LoS street, users 250 m away; 5,000 channel and activation samples, 80/20 train/validation (p. 5, 10).
test_conditions: Trained on 5,000 (H, Z) samples, 80/20 train/validation split; tested over 1,000 random phase-shift realizations and activation matrices of the same setup, plus a CSI-error sweep (p. 10-12).
baselines: Non-learned only: fixed-step PGD (0.15, 50 iterations), CVX per-frame, digital-ZF OFDM-IM, digital-ZF full-tone OFDM, hybrid precoding; no earlier learned method compared (p. 10-12).
metrics: Worst-link loss (negative minimum SINR) versus iterations, average BER versus transmit power and CSI error, sum rate, PAPR CCDF, ML-detector candidate counts (p. 10-13).
complexity: Analytical: total O(Nc T (L M^2 + K^2 M)), per-iteration forward O(Nc (L M^2 + K^2 M)); ML-detector candidates in Table III; no measured runtime (p. 10, 13).
q1_support: p. 10: "Following 3GPP TR 38.901 guidelines for mmWave outdoor micro-cells [59], we set Pk = 10 dominant taps with delays." The channel is the paper's own tapped-delay-line model (Eq. 7, p. 5); only the tap count is said to follow 3GPP, no TR 38.901 generator, TDL or CDL profile is stated.
q2_support: p. 10: "The learning database comprises 5,000 pairs of independently input tuples H for different bitstream data, while an 80%:20% split is used for training and validation." Tests use random draws of the same setup; the CSI-error sweep (Fig. 8) does not count and no model trained elsewhere is tested on a new scenario.
q3_support: p. 10: "UPGD-Net is benchmarked against (i) conventional PGD with a fixed step 0.15 and I = 50 iterations and (ii) CVX"; the other baselines (digital ZF, hybrid precoding, pp. 11-12) are non-learned too. No earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "the total complexity of UPGD-Net is approximated as" O(Nc T (L M^2 + K^2 M)), after a per-iteration forward cost O(Nc (L M^2 + K^2 M)) in the Complexity Analysis.
q5_support: p. 10: "The learning database comprises 5,000 pairs of independently input tuples H": data generated by the paper's own simulator. No code or data link, no public dataset and no measured data is stated anywhere in the paper.
notes: The PDF header states DOI 10.1109/TWC.2026.3713490 (arXiv:2509.22327v3), so it is the paper of its DOI. Included as area 3: the learned UPGD-Net configures the phase shifts of a stacked intelligent metasurface at the BS (stacked RIS, ris=1). Deep unfolding with trained step sizes counts as learned (p. 9-10), although only 30 step sizes are trained and phases are re-optimized per frame (p. 9). q1 is borderline: the reviewer should confirm whether following 3GPP guidelines for the tap count (p. 10) is enough; I read it as a custom channel.
